run_ptb_detokenizer: run the ptb_detokenizer function to detokenize Penn Treebank formatted text strings
run_wikitext_detokenizer: run the wikitext_detokenizer function to detokenize Wikitext formatted text with contractions and punctuation
run_lambada_detokenizer: run the lambada_detokenizer function to pass through LAMBADA text unchanged
run_get_detokenizer: run the get_detokenizer function to look up a detokenizer by dataset name in a path string
review_detokenizers_dict: review the DETOKENIZERS dictionary mapping dataset names to their corresponding detokenizer functions
